question: 2025 年 6 月的客单价是多少？（净销售额 / 有效订单数，净销售额 = 订单金额 − 退款）
sql: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id FROM sales_orders AS o WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'completed') AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-06-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE)), order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.is_gift THEN 0 ELSE i.item_amount END), 0) + o.shipping_fee - o.discount_amount AS order_amount FROM sales_orders AS o JOIN valid_orders AS v ON v.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id, o.shipping_fee, o.discount_amount), refund_sum AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE status = 'success' GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM(n.order_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.order_id) AS valid_order_count, ROUND((SUM(n.order_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refund_sum AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id

question: 2025 年整体毛利率是多少？（订单金额−商品成本−退款）／订单金额，0-1 小数
